scope: US market identity/source/period validation at one representative session date for AAPL plus a secondary MSFT sample; no investment advice.
marketTimeZone: America/New_York (Nasdaq states regular-market hours are in Eastern Time; app metadata exchange timezone is America/New_York)
interval: 1d; raw per-session OHLCV. App request window is five years ending at as-of date; official comparison is for this one date only.

appMethod.functions: upstream(url,true,0) then canonical parseChart(data, asOf); no configuredReader, DB, live application endpoint, source telemetry, or analysis write was used.
appMethod.fieldMapping: symbol/meta.symbol; company/meta.longName plus static Saudi directory; exchange/meta.exchangeName/fullExchangeName; currency/meta.currency; date from timestamp plus meta.gmtoffset; OHLCV from indicators.quote[0] (open/high/low/close/volume); historical price parser reads close, not adjclose.
appMethod.rounding: Compare prices at published two-decimal precision; retain binary floats unchanged in normalized-app-results.json. Volume compared as exact integer shares.

corporateActionDisclosure.appBehavior: Canonical parseChart reads quote.close/volume and event records; it does not read adjclose. AAPL raw chart window has dividend events; no split is in this app query window beginning 2021-09-10. Apple IR says the last stock split was 4-for-1 on 2020-08-28, outside the sample window. MSFT raw chart window contains dividend events; Nasdaq reports last Microsoft split in February 2003 (secondary Nasdaq article, not used to determine sample prices). Values are point-in-time daily OHLCV, not total return.
